record.title: Kyrgyzstan pandemic restriction on foreign land entry
record.exceptions: Citizens; diplomats; freight crews; residents and qualifying family; later students/medical/funeral and listed nationalities
record.enforcement: Primary order gives 19 March effective date; reproduced legal repeal gives 30 April 2022.
record.status_observation: Formal permission or repeal dated by evidence; operational resumption is not independently established for the full stated scope.
record.official_rationale: Prevent introduction and spread of COVID-19.
record.context: Several phased exceptions precede repeal of umbrella entry order.
record.uncertainty: The endpoint is formal repeal, not observed universal reopening. Earlier phased admissions are documented. The separate Tajik conflict ban must be treated independently. The 4 December 2020 airport measure does not establish a land reopening. The repeal’s visible clause and legal-effect metadata are accessible, but the full instrument is paywalled.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established. Date bounds delimit the umbrella legal restriction, which had earlier admission exceptions and amendments. They do not establish uninterrupted closure of all land crossings or a single population throughout.

All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): COVID prevention stated.
Foreign citizens/stateless entry with exemptions; no inference about separate Tajik conflict ban.
